data.name: Annual Performance Review
data.description: Comprehensive yearly performance assessment template covering goal achievement, competency demonstration, and self-reflection. Used company-wide for the annual fiscal-year review cycle.

data.name: Quarterly Check-in
data.description: Lightweight quarterly check-in template focused on goal progress and short-term blockers. Designed to be completed in under 15 minutes.

data.name: Probationary Review
data.description: 90-day check-in template for new hires. Covers ramp-up progress, role clarity, and onboarding feedback. Currently in draft pending HR partnership review.

data.name: 360 Feedback Cycle
data.description: Multi-source feedback template gathering input from manager, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional collaborators. Designed for senior individual contributors and people managers.

data.name: Manager Effectiveness Survey
data.description: Survey template for direct reports to evaluate their manager. Measures coaching effectiveness, communication, and leadership across managerial competencies. Used in the Manager Calibration cycle.

data.name: Peer Feedback Survey
data.description: Standalone peer-feedback template used in the FY2024 and FY2025 cycles. Archived after the 360 Feedback Cycle template (tmpl-004) was published in 2026.
